title: 第一百一十一章 绿芽
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

荒镇的夜，很冷。

林秋靠在那株枯树上，不知不觉，睡着了。

她做了一个梦。

梦里，她又回到了青云宗。不是那个被毁灭的、焦黑的废墟，而是很久以前，她刚入门时的青云宗。

天空很蓝，云朵很白，山间的灵气浓郁得化不开。她穿着崭新的外门弟子服，手里拿着一柄木剑，正在演武场上练习基础剑法。

陈默师兄，就站在不远处。他穿着那身洗得发白的灰布道袍，手里拎着那柄暗金色的柴刀，正在砍柴。

“咔嚓。”

“咔嚓。”

柴刀落下的声音，很有节奏，很好听。

林秋练着练着，就停了下来。她看着陈默师兄的背影，看着他额头上渗出的汗水，看着他专注的眼神。

她忽然很想走过去，跟他说句话。

说，陈默师兄，你的柴刀，好像有点钝了。

或者，陈默师兄，你休息一下吧，我给你倒杯水。

但她刚迈出一步，陈默师兄的背影，忽然就散了。

像一堆沙砾，被风吹散了。

林秋猛地惊醒。

柴房里，依旧是那股霉味和冷风。王虎的鼾声还在响，韩立依旧背对着她，守在门口。

天，还没亮。

林秋的心，还在怦怦直跳。她下意识地，伸手去摸那株枯树。

她的手，触到了一个……柔软的东西。

不是沙砾那种粗糙、坚硬的触感。

而是……一种温润的、带着一丝生机的……柔软。

林秋愣住了。

她猛地凑过去，借着从窗户缝隙透进来的、极其微弱的月光，看向那株枯树。

她看到了。

在那光秃秃的、沙砾构成的枝丫顶端，在那滴眼泪落下的地方，竟然……长出了一点点，嫩绿色的……东西。

那不是沙砾。

那是一点，真正的，活着的……绿芽。

很小，很细，只有米粒那么大。

但它在月光下，微微地，颤动着，散发着一股极其微弱、却无比真实的……生机。

“陈默师兄……”林秋捂住了嘴，眼泪再次涌了出来。

但这一次，不是悲伤的眼泪，而是喜悦的，激动的，不敢置信的眼泪。

他还活着。

他真的，还活着。

林秋不敢大声说话，生怕惊扰了那点嫩芽。她只是小心翼翼地，把脸贴得更近，看着那点绿色，看着它在这个死寂的、冰冷的、绝望的夜里，顽强地，生长着。

“林师妹？”韩立被林秋的动静惊动，转过身，低声问道，“怎么了？”

林秋抬起头，脸上还挂着泪珠，但眼睛里却亮得惊人。她用手指，指了指那株枯树。

韩立顺着她的手指看去。

他看到了那点绿芽。

他的身体，猛地一震。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The night in the deserted town is very cold.

Lin Qiu leaned against the dead tree and fell asleep without knowing it.

She had a dream.

In the dream, she returned to Qingyun Sect again.Not the destroyed, charred ruins, but the Qingyun Sect when she first entered it a long time ago.

The sky is very blue, the clouds are very white, and the spiritual energy in the mountains is so rich that it cannot be dissolved.She was wearing a brand new outer disciple uniform, holding a wooden sword in her hand, and was practicing basic swordsmanship on the martial arts field.

Senior Brother Chen Mo was standing not far away.He was wearing a washed gray preaching robe, holding a dark golden hatchet in his hand, and was chopping wood.

"Click."

"Click."

The sound of the hatchet falling is rhythmic and pleasant.

Lin Qiu practiced and then stopped.She looked at Senior Brother Chen Mo's back, the sweat on his forehead, and his focused eyes.

She suddenly wanted to go over and have a word with him.

Said, Senior Brother Chen Mo, your hatchet seems a bit blunt.

Or, senior brother Chen Mo, please take a rest and I'll get you a glass of water.

But as soon as she took a step, Senior Brother Chen Mo's back suddenly disappeared.

Like a pile of gravel, blown away by the wind.

Lin Qiu woke up suddenly.

In the woodshed, there was still that musty smell and cold wind.Wang Hu was still snoring, and Han Li was still standing guard at the door with his back to her.

It's not bright yet.

Lin Qiu's heart was still pounding.Subconsciously, she reached out to touch the dead tree.

Her hand touched something... soft.

Not the rough, hard touch of gravel.

But...a kind of warmth, with a hint of vitality...softness.

Lin Qiu was stunned.

She leaned forward suddenly and looked at the dead tree with the extremely weak moonlight coming through the gap in the window.

She saw it.

On the top of the bare branches made of gravel, where the tears fell, there was... a little bit of tender green... something growing.

That's not gravel.

That's a little, real, living...green shoot.

Very small, very thin, only as big as a grain of rice.

But under the moonlight, it trembled slightly, exuding an extremely weak but extremely real... vitality.

"Senior Brother Chen Mo..." Lin Qiu covered her mouth, tears welling up again.

But this time, it was not tears of sadness, but tears of joy, excitement, and disbelief.

He is still alive.

He is really still alive.

Lin Qiu didn't dare to speak loudly for fear of disturbing the young shoots.She just cautiously pressed her face closer, looking at the green spot and watching it grow tenaciously in this dead, cold, and desperate night.

"Junior Sister Lin?" Han Li was alarmed by Lin Qiu's movements, turned around, and asked in a low voice, "What's wrong?"

Lin Qiu raised his head, with tears still hanging on his face, but his eyes were surprisingly bright.She pointed at the dead tree with her finger.

Han Li looked along her fingers.

He saw the green sprout.

His body shook violently.
